transcript: Who deserves the credit for this victory? Whoever takes the helm, that's what any pilot would say. But a pilot is nobody without a robot. Can pilots capture beacons by themselves or dispatch a titan to the scrapyard? The robot is everything. But when the robot was caught off guard, this tiny drone saved it from obliteration. So, was it the drone that was the key? Or was it the orbital support that gave this robot a shield earlier on? Or those grenade launchers with their stunning rate of fire and blast effect? So, in the end, who deserves the praise here? Well, you do, for sure. The robot's abilities, the powerful weapons, and the pilot's skills. Everything worked together for a common cause. But it was your idea to bring them together, Commander. This is your achievement. Don't slow down. Be ingenious. Happy hunting!
metadata_caption: NEW ROBOT: Ophion 🐍 Robot Overview — War Robots
